steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's been a long time, Buldrokkas'tee.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Dame, Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Why don't... you age?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Shieldguards. Guerrillas. Stand by. Hold position.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Lord.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The way you talk... is that because of an infected organ in your larynx?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: No. Just, over time, became like this. I can't, speak smoothly, anymore.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Dame... I never thought, I'd see you, again.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I remember, faintly. When my people, left. You and, Her Majesty, didn't stop us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That was a long, long time ago.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I was, in my prime. Now I know, too sudden. I was wrong, about the King.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...You'll still call her 'Majesty' and 'King.'

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: A king, is a king.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: When I left, she wasn't. Now, she has passed.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You still distinguish the King of Kazdel and the Emperor of Ursus.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Decorum. War does not, muddle, my thoughts. Who I served? All gone.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Ursus now, is my homeland, too. My liege, buried in Ursus. Vast land.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...To long, Dame. When we left...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My people were, not yet withered. Still, it was not, long.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But you... no change. The years, did not change you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Not true. The years have changed us all, Buldrokkas'tee. I'm not the same woman I was before.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Buldrokkas'tee... why did you leave Kazdel?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Why I left, I think, you will laugh.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I left, because, I hated killing.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...But for my life, I have killed.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All that you've been through has only tempered your will. Your blood still flows in your veins. I will not laugh at you. You've earned respect.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: High praise, Dame. I failed to avoid, killing. I did, kill so many.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Dame, this name... Do you know, how I got it?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your followers consider you a true warrior, fighting for Ursus. You fight injustice, slavery, bloodshed and oppression for the future of Ursus.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do you agree?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: (Shakes his head)

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Even if war, is necessary, such a title, is trouble.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: For many, we started war. But war, is murder.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The war ends. If it, truly, ends. We should, all die.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But war never ends.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But I will die.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But, for my death, I want, meaning. I want to see, for Ursus, for the Infected, another future.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I asked, many times, of my people, Kazdel. You and, Her Majesty, worked together, for many years. She trusted you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: So, I too, trust you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You led, Rhodes Island, here. Not for blood.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...But them, those two. They stink, of my daughter. Her death.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Patriot...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: No. No more.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do you seek vengeance on Rhodes Island, Patriot?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: No, Dame. Not vengeance.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Why take, vengeance, for her, actions?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: That was, her path. She chose. No matter, where it ended.

options: Your daughter fought us with everything she had!
And she approved of us too.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Quiet.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Mr. Patriot?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: She's, so young. Only knows, blind trust.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The truth, we believed, in the end, is exposed. Only a few, wolves, in sheep's clothing.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Patriot! Miss FrostNova gave her life, her Arts... everything...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Miss FrostNova let go of everything just to prove herself, her anger, her ideals...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Her life had meaning!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Enough. Not your place, to say this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Amiya, don't. Say no more.)

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: What, do you know?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If my daughter, was not, terminal... Killing you, would be easy, for her. Like slicing wheat, with a sickle.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: What you, endured, I do not care.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: It means, nothing. It proves, nothing.

options: Talulah has set the core city on a collision course for Lungmen!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: And is she, declaring it, Ursus territory?

options: Seems like we can skip that part.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Patriot... how... then why...?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The puppetmaster, has many tools. Puppetmasters, think alike.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But I cannot, let you through. Reunion, cannot destroy, itself.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I won't, betray again. Or they, the Infected, the struggle, are for nothing. They die.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Even if, Talulah, has gone mad...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: How do I tell, the Infected, their leader, is mad? A traitor?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: How do I say, she is wrong now, but once right? How do I say, she, who you follow, must now die?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I won't let, Reunion, become 'Infected, civil war, then nothing.' I will not.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But Reunion won't be able to carry its own weight. And besides, Talulah has been working secretly to destroy Reunion from within.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You are right, Dame Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: And so, you are here.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I prepared, to face, many types of foe.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But I did not, expect, in the end, to fight Infected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Is this really what you choose?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Buldrokkas'tee... You don't have to die.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Choose? I have only, one choice.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: To kill you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Patriot, we don't need to throw more lives away! This isn't like it was with Miss FrostNova! No matter who wins, this battle is playing right into the enemy's hands!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Wrong.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Cautus, this, is war.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You want me, to stop. Why, should I stop?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I fought far, too many wars.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: As the, Wendigo, of Ursus... barbarians. Flayers, ripped flesh from bone, vicious herds, we cleansed.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Monsters. Twisted, stinking limbs, eyes in the, hundreds. Fingers in, the thousands. We slaughtered.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Warriors. Victoria, with steam armor. Kazimierz, with Silverlance Pegasi. Laterano, with Apostolic, Gun-Knights. All of them, we defeated, utterly.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But we cannot, defeat ourselves. Cannot defeat, the Empire's greed. Cannot defeat, our people's deaths.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: We, the Wendigos, are the Sarkaz, closest, to death.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You are stained, with my daughter's death.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: In this world, there are fates, worse than death.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Why should I stop? Who dares, test me? My virtue?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: They called me, righteous. Should I, accept?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Fate thinks me weak. Do I suffer it? They called me strong. Should I bear it?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Traitor, rebel, butcher, guardian...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: All of them, like 'Patriot.' On the battlefield, they are nothing, but scraps.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You killed her. I'll kill you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: It is not, revenge. I have no heart, for vengeance.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My daughter just, gave up the fight.

options: That's not how it is, sir.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If not, then how? She gave her life, and you still live?!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I, will not, give up.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I only know, what I see. I only know, what I hold.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I don't fight you, for my daughter.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...But I loathe fate.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I will fell it, crush it, grind it to dust.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If fate, lets you, make me turn.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I would rather, never turn, back.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...Captain! Are you really going to...?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Anyone who, thinks me, dishonorable. Stand now, challenge me.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But if you, value your life... We part, here.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I don't want, for you, a foolish death. I won many times. I know this, too well.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You can't...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Buldrokkas'tee, don't be stupid, you can live on.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Dame, you too, have tasted loss.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: And so, could you, stand by, and watch?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —You—

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My blood, no longer, serves her. Yes. My country... is Ursus.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But when she, died. We heard it... that long, long gasp.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So you could feel it...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That was the moment with the pulse containing her Arts spread through the body of every Sarkaz in the world.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It was only an instant. But you felt it. That means your blood... is ancient enough.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: So ancient that, I am alone.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I never thought, born in Kazdel, never Infected... Then, an old man, I tasted it, Oripathy.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Is that right?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: We all know, Dame. We all know. Things in this world, do not happen, because they are, right.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: In fact, most things, are mistakes, again.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My men said, I can fix them. In fact, they are too many. There is no, looking back.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Do you fight, to this day, for what, you lost, Dame?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I think, no.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I think, you lost, and you refuse, to lose more.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My daughter, has passed.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: —I fight not, for her death. I fight, for the living, for all Infected, to the end.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Reunion, cannot fail.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Reunion must, liberate. All Infected.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Are you sending messages for him and his men?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: What will you say to him?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...You're trying to set up the guerrillas. You're... you're going to turn the Ursus Infected against them, to kill them.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: You know they won't raise a hand against the civilians.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Hate is the strongest weapon. It's a killer.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: But he won't die.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: He's Patriot... he's all the greatest legends summed up in one man. I've seen his armor. I've seen him swing a weapon.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: He can't die! He and his people are the strongest fighters in all Reunion!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: You want to kill the Infected. You devils never cared about life, but he does!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: He's Ursus... he's Sarkaz, and he's Infected! But none of those qualities push him to do wrong!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: He's not just Ursus, he's not just Sarkaz, he's not just an Infected. He's the Patriot, just the Patriot.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: He'll beat you, he'll block your attacks, spit on your insults, regroup the Infected, and cleanse their hate...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: He's Patriot, and he won't die.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: And you're a bunch of maggots, dancing on the strings of the disgusting schemers running this show.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You're talking like that because you know you're gonna die.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: And you're definitely right about that.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Patriot's pretty tough. But you're not. You're gonna die.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: So you, will not pass. I will not, allow it.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: To go through, central district, you have to, kill me.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Otherwise, my guerrillas, will hunt. And I, will be here, strangling you, to death.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You will die, at my hands.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Only if, you kill me, will your value, be known. Otherwise, you are only, intruders.

options: I'm afraid I don't really follow.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Of course, I don't believe, you have any, value.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I don't know, how you could, resist, my people's, witchcraft. But you will not, survive, Ursus tactics.

options: You really hate us that much?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I don't hate, anyone.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I just don't, trust you. I cannot, trust.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Even you, Lord. You brought...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You won't approve of us.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I don't believe, in coincidences.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: War.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: War, does not care. Not about right, or wrong.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: It does not, care about, the suffering, or the oppressed, or the enslaved. Off the battlefield, there are. On the battlefield, there are not.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You must prepare, for the battlefield.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Whoever dies, is wrong.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I can't... I can't understand him...!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: What is he saying... why do we have to fight?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Fight, or be crushed.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Resist, and be crushed.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Unless, you defeat, me.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If fate, stands with me, I kill you. Then I, shall kill it. So it cannot, mock anyone, ever again.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If fate, stands with you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I can only, go forward. Advance.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All operators, fall back, immediately!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I step forward.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Our target is an Infected commander of the Reunion movement, code name: 'Patriot.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: His armor, his strength, his stature, far surpass anything you would expect of a warrior.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Originium may have taken over many of his physiological functions. The Originium in what was once his larynx... is a product of the high rate of crystallization happening inside his body.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's the most we've been able to gather from our intel.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have reason to believe that a typically fatal wound will not do any significant damage to him, as the Originium will grow and replace tissue damage!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Wendigos naturally exhibit an extremely high metabolic and repair capacity. And from where we stand, we don't know whether his infection is causing him pain, or is a benign mutation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But no matter how resilient he may be, we have to kill him.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Only by killing him can we get through the central district, reach the bridge, and stop the enemy's exploitation of Reunion!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: His guards have been confused by his actions. This is our last chance.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit...

options: How did it come to this?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...We're just a fork in his road. All that we've built means nothing to him.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're a choice just like 'go kill Talulah right now.' But I think that one carries more weight to him, might be worth further investigation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: To put it frankly, he's looking down on us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even with Dr. Kal'tsit here...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even the Emperor of Ursus himself couldn't get him to bow his head, let alone me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We'll have to use his death... to open his eyes, and make him see all that we've done, and make him realize that we're stronger than him.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But there's no way he himself could ever... change. Everything else, all that you value, is too fragile for him. It can't bear his weight.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Hellagur from Azazel misjudged this Sarkaz's character.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...No matter how noble Buldrokkas'tee may be, no matter how much he carries on his shoulders, he is an indomitable warrior, first and foremost.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: FrostNova trusted you, so she gave the last bit of her life to you... But Patriot does not.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He doesn't trust. He only trusts himself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (...Even outwardly.)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Prepare for battle. It all comes down to battle now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Only war can kill him.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Wise choice, Lord.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Guerrillas, regroup.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You have only, a few minutes left.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I say, no more.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I seek no, understanding. I only, win wars.
Defying all comprehension, the monstrously fearsome warrior stands before you.
But, you remember, there is another monstrous warrior who comprehends everything, standing right beside you...
Amiya grips your hand tightly.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Rhodes Island, I advance.
